description_en: Returns a Browser Monitoring application object based on the application PID
description_zh: 根据前端监控应用Pid返回前端监控应用对象
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-retcode-app-by-pid --pid b590lhguqs@9781be0f44dXXXX --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRetcodeAppByPid

parameters.help_en: The application PID. In the ARMS console, choose Browser Monitoring > Application List and click the target application name. The URL in the browser address bar contains the PID of the application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the PID slightly. For example, if the PID in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, replace %40 with @, that is, xxx@74xxx
parameters.help_zh: 应用PID。在ARMS控制台的前端监控>前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```aliyun```和```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或 ```https://```
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:, or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag key-value pairs. This parameter is required if you do not specify the ResourceIds parameter. Description of the values: key: the tag key. The key must be 1 to 128 characters in length. value: the tag value. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. Tags are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, multiple tags are created and associated with the specified resource at the same time. A tag key on the same resource can correspond to only one tag value. If you attempt to add an existing tag key, the corresponding tag value is updated to the new value. The tag cannot start with aliyun or acs:, and cannot contain http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：                              key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
parameters.name: tags

RetcodeApp.description_zh: 前端监控应用返回数据

AppId.description_en: The application ID, which is an auto-increment field in the database

AppName.description_en: The name of the Browser Monitoring application

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group ID. You can obtain this value from the Resource Management console
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源组ID，您可以通过资源管理控制台获取

RetcodeAppType.description_en:
The type of the Browser Monitoring application. Valid values:

`web`: Web page.
`weex`: Weex page.
`mini_dd`: DingTalk mini program.
`mini_alipay`: Alipay mini program.
`mini_wx`: WeChat mini program.
`mini_common`: Other mini program

`mini_dd`：钉钉小程序
